import os,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
active=root/'current'
paths={'apktool':root/'tools/apktool-3.0.3/bin/apktool','valkey':root/'tools/ferrari-services/valkey-server/bin/valkey-server'}
d={'audit':'old_launcher_exact_content_before_canonicalization','active':str(active.resolve(strict=True)),'launchers':{},'alias_present':Path('/home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari').is_symlink()}
assert active.resolve(strict=True).name=='70458fc1b44102b440d2d4c335b5e54f5279f25c'
for name,p in paths.items():
 item={'path':str(p),'exists':p.exists(),'is_symlink':p.is_symlink()}
 if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
  b=p.read_bytes()
  item.update({'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'owner_uid':p.stat().st_uid,'size_bytes':len(b),'old_alias_count':b.count(b'.local/share/motor-ferrari'),'mode':oct(p.stat().st_mode & 0o777)})
  text=b.decode('utf8','replace')
  item['root_private_assignments']=[l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith(('ROOT=','PRIVATE=','JAVA=','JAR=','FRAME=','exec '))][:15]
  cmd=subprocess.run([str(p),'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
  item['version_exit']=cmd.returncode
  item['version_first_line']=(cmd.stdout or cmd.stderr).splitlines()[:2]
 d['launchers'][name]=item
print(json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True))
assert all(x['exists'] and not x['is_symlink'] for x in d['launchers'].values())
